summary: Every approval covers exactly one change set, and automated test runs are clearly labelled in the audit trail.

fixes.title: Stronger protection for approvals
fixes.text: Each approval covers exactly the policy changes that were reviewed.

fixes.title: Automated runs are named in the audit trail
fixes.text: Automated test runs are now recorded as that automation, acting as the signed-in account, instead of under a person's name. A hosted Manager always records the real signed-in person.
